g.text: 3rd normal form — abuse booleans duplicate escalator codes (ghosting, strawman, refusal...); escalator lists hardcoded in CHECKs and lookup tables; text[] repeating groups in projects
Appropriate indexing — every FK and join-table second column indexed; unique lookups (slug, lower(name)) indexed; no redundant indexes found

Least privilege — RLS on all tables and anon/authenticated revoked; logins.password stored plaintext
